name: EH3D-PHOENIX-PCB
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.1: early code. EDA environment planned as schematic capture, PCB layout, verification tools, circuit simulation and specialized modules for switch-mode power supplies and RF; it is the main project of the PHOENIX family. What exists is a Rust workspace with a library and a command, phoenix inventory, that counts the design files of a private folder in redacted mode. It has only run on folders made by its own tests; the design model, readers, rules and editors are planned and nothing has been run on a machine.
